Emma: Heads-up—night deploy window starts 22:00 UTC. who can actually press tonight? MFA page shows the enrollment job is failing :grimacing:
Raj: I'm on call but MFA enrollment for a subset of deployers is flaky. can we request a short-lived delegate for this push? @Taylor?
Taylor: I can request JIT for myself, but we still need one approved Deployer role. pinging @Olivia to confirm she can press if needed.
Olivia: I can press, but only if we pin the runtime to v2.14.1. previous rollback taught us not to mix versions during canary. :white_check_mark:
Deploy-Bot: deploy requested by Taylor for service=web-frontend, version=v2.14.1-canary, change_window=2026-03-20T22:00Z
Sina: Quick question — do we want canary ratio 10% -> 50% -> 100% or skip to 30%? logs show tail latency reduction with small batches.
Raj: Let's do 10% -> 50% after 15m -> full after 45m unless error rate >1%. I'll set autoscaling to conservative.
Emma: Also need audit trail for JIT elevation. Raj, can you add the approval note to the ticket? ticket #INT-4721
Raj: added: "JIT approved for Taylor, backup Olivia. MFA exception temporary until enroll job fixed." 
Taylor: I'll press at 22:02 UTC and watch traces. if errors spike I'll trigger rollback and tag @eng-sre.
Olivia: If rollback is needed, prepare rollback tag v2.14.0-rollback and don't promote any caches.
Deploy-Bot: deployment started: web-frontend v2.14.1-canary -> 10% (task_id=deploy-3472001111-01)
Emma: thanks team. keeping channel open. :rocket:
